scope: Numerical HUD/World comparison over all speed-chapter frames only. Does not rerender or certify subtitles, image quality, splice decoding, or audio.
method: Verify exact current Film HUD/progress expressions; use actual imported World.forceScaleForSpeedMultiplier, easing function, timeline, and balance.json; compare all 749 frames.

rounding.interpretation: A tiny piecewise-linear data interpolation difference crosses one decimal rounding boundary at one frame. The HUD uses the correct analytic square; the World arrow is effectively identical in length.

subtitleReview.reviewType: Read-only source-text review; no new audio listening or transcription

clips.text: 再把身体姿势和迎风面积固定，只改变吹来的风。
常用的阻力估算里，风速加倍，力大约会变为四倍。
这里用的是人身边的相对风速，不能直接拿列车速度代进去。
列车速度、车型和隧道形状，会一起决定周围的风。
这些变化交给工程师测量；我们先做好一件简单的事，留在线后。

subtitleReview.conclusion: The script fixes posture and frontal area, describes the standard drag estimate as approximately fourfold when relative wind speed doubles, and explicitly distinguishes local relative wind from train speed. No wording/audio change is needed for this HUD correction.

previousVisualAudit.reason: The prior audit explicitly excludes React HUD/text and its Film hash predates this change. Its unchanged World/data coverage remains valid. Corrected HUD appearance and patch seams require the targeted new segment checks.
